scope: Two development episodes per arm per candidate; not a reserved evaluation or a reliability estimate.
limits: RGB visibility, observation age and full observation/ACT feature tensors were not saved in these evaluation traces; their normalized extrapolation cannot be reconstructed.
Reconstructed gripper-clock statistics follow the causal selected-command threshold; other normalized input extrapolation was not measured.
The tracker fits confident sphere detections to the declared table support plane; a remembered reference is not evidence of a current carried object.
The tracked0 auxiliary phase labels used post-step teacher phase; boundary labels can be one phase ahead of the command. Later collection corrects this without modifying these immutable packs.
Generic and phase heads differ in both architecture and normalization (phase clamps normalized inputs to +/-10); the comparison does not isolate phase supervision alone.
The no-ACT ablation removes both the ACT prior and decoder features; these tests do not isolate their separate causal effects.

RGB reference errors use the previous post-step scoring ball position to align with the next pre-step perception call; privileged positions are audit-only. Large all-table errors can include balls outside the detector workspace; the report separates in-workspace errors.
findings: Generic ACT-conditioned recovery completed 0/2 per arm. SO101 final IK rejected 1375/1500 ticks at the command stop margin; Panda rejected 1214/1500 ticks outside workspace. These are predicted-action feasibility failures, not aborted episodes.
No-ACT recovery completed 1/2 SO101 and 0/2 Panda tasks. The SO101 success held the ball for 75 ticks and completed in 255 ticks; the failed SO101 trial never held it.

Phase-supervised recovery completed 0/2 per arm. Panda seed12000 accepted all 750 IK requests but never held or lifted the ball, while predicting TRANSPORT for 229, LIFT for 151, LOWER for 85 and RELEASE for 61 ticks. Physical grasp confirmation is missing even when IK is feasible.

The successful SO101 no-ACT trial stayed within the training gripper-clock range. Several failed generic trials reached >10 training standard deviations in that clock; generic inputs are unclamped. This supports a covariate-shift bottleneck but is not an intervention establishing causation.
source_set_contract: Each exact source map is shared_runtime_source_sha256 merged with source_sets[source_set_id]; source_set_id is SHA256 of sorted-key JSON of that full map.

visual_spot_checks.observation: Ball is beside the outside of a jaw near the table, rather than contained between the fingers; agrees with zero held/lifted ticks.
Ball rests in the observed bowl after the gripper has retreated; agrees with complete-task scoring.
